text:
toni: quick design ping — re: playground run-history. the arg-preview is hover-only and it9s noisy when JSON blobs show inline. thinking click-to-toggle + compact summary line.

may: +1. hover-only breaks on touch. click toggle should use aria-expanded and a focused heading inside the panel. for tiny rows we need a single-word label. options: "Preview", "Inspect", "Value". prefer "Preview".

rui: accessibility notes: when opened move focus to the panel heading (role=region with aria-labelledby). Escape closes and returns focus. announce: "Expanded argument preview for <arg>". Important: do not trap focus; allow tabbing out.

toni: visual idea: show type + count when value is large, e.g. "object (3)", "array (12)". clicking that area toggles a mini-json viewer. keeps rows tidy.

izzy: copy + localization: avoid punctuation and verbs implying network action. keep label < 12 chars. i9ll add loc note.

toni: tiny CSS suggestion to avoid layout jumps: animate opacity and max-height rather than width. pseudocode: `.panel { max-height:0; opacity:0 } .open { max-height:240px; opacity:1 }`.

may: microcopy for a11y-only tooltip: "Open argument preview for <arg>". ui label: "Preview". chevron shows state. touch target >= 44px.

rui: visual contrast: chevron must meet 4.5:1 in both states. truncated token use single-character ellipsis (\u2026) not three dots. add visible focus ring for keyboard.

toni: telemetry idea: emit event when users expand previews. if usage < 2% consider hiding toggle under a condensed menu.

qa-bot: QA checklist added to ticket: keyboard open/close, screen reader announce, escape+return focus, mobile tap target, virtualization regression test.

izzy: i'll add copy variants and loc guidance to PL-2147. may: can you mock the compact row with the "object (N)" summary? rui: please add the a11y checklist. toni will wire telemetry. sync 15m after lunch. :calendar:
